SELECT DATE_FORMAT(session_start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS connDate, COUNT(*) AS connUserCnt FROM svc_mbr_session WHERE session_start_dt >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND session_start_dt < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(session_start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY connDate ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, MAX(concurrent_users_cnt) AS max_concurrent_users_cnt FROM svc_mbr_session_concurrent_users_cnt WHERE reg_dt BETWEEN #{startDate} AND CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT
CASE WHEN m.mbr_role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' THEN '시스템 관리자' ELSE m.ownr_nm END AS ownr_nm, COUNT(*) AS '건수' FROM svc_stat_lgn s JOIN svc_mbr_data m ON s.mbr_id = m.mbr_id WHERE 1=1
AND s.reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDt}, ' 00:00:00') AND s.reg_dt <= CONCAT(#{endDt}, ' 23:59:59')
AND s.act_type_cd = 'L' AND m.ownr_nm IS NOT NULL
AND m.ownr_nm = #{ownrNm}
GROUP BY m.ownr_nm

SELECT ss.mbr_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, smd.mbr_role, CASE WHEN smd.mbr_role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' THEN '시스템 관리자' ELSE smd.ownr_nm END AS ownr_nm, MAX(ss.reg_dt) AS reg_dt FROM svc_stat_lgn ss JOIN svc_mbr_data smd ON ss.mbr_id = smd.mbr_id WHERE 1=1
AND ss.reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDt}, ' 00:00:00') AND ss.reg_dt <= CONCAT(#{endDt}, ' 23:59:59')
AND ss.act_type_cd = 'L'
AND smd.ownr_nm = #{ownrNm}
GROUP BY ss.mbr_id, smd.mbr_role, smd.ownr_nm
ORDER BY reg_dt DESC
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_dt,
DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m') AS reg_dt,
COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS '접속 건수' FROM svc_stat_use s WHERE 1=1
AND reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDt}, ' 00:00:00') AND reg_dt <= CONCAT(#{endDt}, ' 23:59:59')
AND m.ownr_nm = #{ownrNm}
GROUP BY DATE(reg_dt) ORDER BY DATE(reg_dt)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m')

SELECT svc_nm , svc_nm2 , COUNT(*) as '건수' FROM svc_stat_use WHERE 1=1
AND reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDt}, ' 00:00:00') AND reg_dt <= CONCAT(#{endDt}, ' 23:59:59')
AND ownr_nm = #{ownrNm}
GROUP BY svc_nm2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) desc
